newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Spaniard Morantinos named as EU envoy to Mideast.
newsitem.headline: Spaniard Morantinos named as EU envoy to Mideast.

text.p: The European Union on Monday named Spanish diplomat Miguel Angel Moratinos to be its special envoy to the Middle East, German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said.
Kinkel said Moratinos will give up his current position as Spain's ambassador to Israel to concentrate on the task.
Diplomats said Moratinos had been given a mandate to observe the peace process, establish relations with Israeli and Palestinian negotiators and to report on possible EU actions.
EU leaders agreed to appoint an envoy at their special summit in Dublin on October 5.
The 15-nation bloc, urged on by France, has been seeking to play a greater role in the Middle East peace process, where it is already the chief financial backer.

EU officials said Moratinos was a very knowledgeable diplomat with years of experience in the Middle East. He is currently also director of Spain's Institute for cooperation with Africa and the Middle East.
